name: Census Tract 163.06, Guilford County, North Carolina
narrative: Responding to cries for help, the police broke into a home and found two adults and three children dead inside. The police are considering it a murder-suicide.

name: Census Tract 1054, Cuyahoga County, Ohio
narrative: Martin Muniz was arrested ad charged with killing his step-father, sister, nephew, as well as a friend of his sister. Another victim was shot but survived.

name: Census Tract 9.01, Tulare County, California
narrative: Six people were fatally shot inside and outside a residence. The two suspects who were arrested two weeks later were known members of the Norteño gang The police believe that the shooting was the likely result of a conflict with members of the Sureños, a rival gang.

name: Census Tract 4822.01, Los Angeles County, California
narrative: A gunman opened fire at a ballroom dance studio during a Chinese Lunar New Year celebration. The assailant, identified as Huu Can Tran, 72, then killed himself during a stand-off with the police.

name: Census Tract 6137.02, San Mateo County, California
narrative: Seven people were killed in two related shootings at a mushroom farm and a trucking firm in Half Moon Bay, California. A suspect—66-year-old Chunli Zhao—then drove to a police substation to surrender.

name: Census Tract 401.01, Union County, Tennessee
narrative: Charles Damon Aljumaily, 52, shot four children and then set fire to the house before taking his own life.

name: Census Tract 9503.01, Tate County, Mississippi
narrative: Richard Dale Crum, 52, allegedly shot to death his ex-wife and five others at two residences and outside a store in Arkabutla, MS. Crum was arrested and charged with murder.

name: Census Tract 107.04, Baldwin County, Alabama
narrative: The police were called to investigate a shooting at an home in Daphne, AL. They found one person dead inside the home and three dead in the backyard. Tarant Smith-Bracy, 21, was arrested in connection to the shooting and stabbing deaths of four family members.

name: Census Tract 621.13, Brevard County, Florida
narrative: Responding to a 911 call, Sheriff's deputies discovered four victims shot to death and two minor children who were unharmed. Domenico Gigante, who was the ex-boyfriend of one of the victims and the father of another, was arrested and charged with four counts of murder.

name: Census Tract 128.01, Miami-Dade County, Florida
narrative: Performing a welfare check, the police found three women and two men dead in an apparent murder-suicide

name: Census Tract 204.02, Dallas County, Texas
narrative: Responding to a report of gunfire, the police found four people shot dead inside an apartment building. Reportedly the shooting arouse out of a custody dispute between one of the alleged assailants and one of the victims. A child was also found in the apartment who was unharmed.

name: Census Tract 21, Jefferson County, Alabama
narrative: The police in Alabama arrested Daniel P. Watson, 28, for suspicion of committing two double homicides on the same day, one in Birmingham and the other in Ragland.

name: Census Tract 17.01, Sumter County, South Carolina
narrative: Aletha Holliday was in her backyard of her home with a co-worker when her ex-husband, Charles Slacks, Jr., entered the home using a key, walked outside and fatally shot Holiday’s coworker. Slacks then went back inside and began to go upstairs, where his two sons and step-daughter were sleeping. Despite Holiday’s efforts to stop him, Slacks proceeded up the stairs where he shot the three children to death. Slacks then took his own life.

name: Census Tract 179.02, Davidson County, Tennessee
narrative: A woman opened fire at a private religious elementary school, killing three adults and three children. She was killed during an exchange of fire with the police.

name: Census Tract 106.05, Ouachita Parish, Louisiana
narrative: Michael Jarrod Cooper Was arrested and charged with murder for allegedly setting fire that killed four people.

name: Census Tract 7526.01, Frederick County, Maryland
narrative: Four people were killed and nine others were injured inside a bank by a employee. The assailant was killed during the confrontation with the police.

name: Census Tract 9624, Tallapoosa County, Alabama
narrative: Two brothers and a third person have been charged with fatally shooting four victims and injuring as many as 32 others during a ""Sweet 16"" birthday party inside the Mahogany Masterpiece dance studio.

name: Census Tract 9702, Sagadahoc County, Maine
narrative: Joseph Eaton, 34, was arrested after he allegedly shot and killed his parents and two of their friends in a Bowdoin, ME residence and then fired at vehicles on Interstate 95 in Yarmouth, injuring three people.

name: Census Tract 2001.06, San Jacinto County, Texas
narrative: A Texas man went next door with a AR-style rifle and began shooting his neighbors, killing five inside the house. According to the authorities, this occurred after the family asked him to stop firing rounds in his yard because they were trying to sleep. After several days on the run, Francisco Oropeza, 38, was arrested a charged in connection to the murders.

name: Census Tract 59, Kern County, California
narrative: Three women and one man were fatally shot late at night inside two RVs in Mojave, CA.

name: Census Tract 8, Okmulgee County, Oklahoma
narrative: Jesse McFadden fatally shot his wife, her children, and friends of her children in his home and then took his own life.

name: Census Tract 143.03, Polk County, Florida
narrative: Al Stenson, 38, fatally shot his girlfriend and her three children inside her apartment. He later died in a shootout with the police.

name: Census Tract 314.18, Collin County, Texas
narrative: A gunman opened fire at the Allen Premium Outlets mall. He was then killed by the police.

name: Census Tract 109.05, Bowie County, Texas
narrative: Cesar Olalde, 19, has been charged with fatally shooting four family members. Reportedly, he thought his family members were cannibals and would eat him.

name: Census Tract 4214, Maricopa County, Arizona
narrative: Iren Byers, 20, is charged with killing four people and injuring another in a series of shootings in Phoenix (one killed) and Mesa (three killed).

name: Census Tract 502.03, Marion County, Tennessee
narrative: Gary Don Barnett killed his estranged wife, her daughter, two of their grandchildren, and another child. He also set fire to the house and then took his own life. A sixth victim was shot three times but survived.

name: Census Tract 9603, Shoshone County, Idaho
narrative: A 31-year-old man has been arrested in connection with the fatal shooting of his neighbors. Reportedly, the incident follows longstanding conflict between the parties. However, the precipitant, according to the police, is that Kaylor was upset that the neighbor’s 18-year-old son had reportedly exposed himself to the man’s children.

name: Census Tract 71.01, Philadelphia County, Pennsylvania
narrative: A 40-year-old man was arrested in connection with fatal shooting of four people and wounding of two children.

name: Census Tract 246.01, Caddo Parish, Louisiana
narrative: Gunfire broke out at a block party, resulting in four fatalities and seven others injured. No arrests have been made.

name: Census Tract 705.05, Henry County, Georgia
narrative: Longmore, 40, fatally shot four of his neighbors. A day later, while on the run, he was killed in a shootout with the police during which three officers were injured.
